headline: Recommended all-way stop signs at French Street and Abbott Street and granting the Juliana Avenue street acceptance; camping ordinances remain tabled.
summary: A public hearing on the Juliana Avenue street acceptance petition drew no testimony. Members voted to recommend final passage of an ordinance for an all-way stop at French Street and Abbott Street, and to recommend granting the Juliana Avenue petition.
decisions: Accepted a communication from Senior Traffic Engineer Wayne R. Husband on Division of Public Works support of O-26-024, and placed it on file.
Recommended final passage of O-26-024, authorizing additional stop signs to make an all-way stop at French Street and Abbott Street; motion carried.
Recommended granting the petition for street acceptance of Juliana Avenue; motion carried.
Tabled O-26-004, repealing the prohibition on camping on public property; it was tabled at the 4/22/26 meeting.
Tabled O-26-005, repealing the prohibition on campers and recreational vehicles on public property; it was tabled at the 4/22/26 meeting.
Tabled the petition for L Deerwood Drive, Lot H-103; it was tabled at the 2/28/24 meeting.
